TRADE_OTC_DESK_LAW.note: TEST quote desk law: 20 bps disclosed spread, a 100 IFC stake floor (J-copy-bots-otc-24 stakes it; one below it is refused), the platform as counterparty, a 60 s firm quote so a journey sees one expire, a reference price trusted for one day (the stack's boot-stamped TEST mid), a 60 s window to settle an accepted quote so a journey sees one close, and a 1000 USDT desk minimum per request (J-copy-bots-otc-24 #4 asks below it and is refused), and BTC as the one asset the desk quotes, the base of the stack's one TEST mid (J-copy-bots-otc-24 #1 reads it back, and blank it refuses), and full verification as the lowest level the desk prices for, the level the stack's verify step grants (J-copy-bots-otc-24 #3 asks at basic and is refused, and blank it refuses).

TRADE_OTC_MAKER_DIRECTORY.note: TEST provider list for the quote desk: the house desk (the platform prices it) and three TEST outside providers, each with a LOCAL TEST spread (10, 30 and 10 bps; refused unless APP_ENV is dev or test) so one request collects one TEST-labelled quote per provider, settled against the house inventory with no outside routing, with at most 3 picked per request (J-copy-bots-otc-24 #2 picks four and is refused; #5 ranks the quotes). Not real providers and not real spreads.

TRADE_OTC_CONVERT_BOUNDS.note: TEST size range for a conversion at the desk price: 0.1 to 5 BTC, so J-copy-bots-otc-24 #9 converts 0.2 inside it, and blank it refuses trade.convert_bounds_not_set. One-click buy is left out, so it reads not set.

TRADE_OTC_MIDS.note: TEST reference price for the quote desk: the TEST BTC/USDT book's start price on the local stack, stamped at boot. Not a market price.
